data.content:
# =====================================================================
# Data ID : appointment-service.yaml
# Group   : PETCLINIC_TEST
# 用途    : 自动化测试 / 课堂演示环境（test）
#
# 动态验证：config-test.sh 把 max-advance-days 从 7 改成 60，
# 再调 POST /api/appointments，原本 400 的请求会变成 201，服务不重启。
# =====================================================================
petclinic:
  env: test
  booking:
    max-advance-days: 7

spring:
  datasource:
    hikari:
      maximum-pool-size: 10
      minimum-idle: 4

  cloud:
    openfeign:
      client:
        config:
          default:
            # test 环境超时收紧，验证「配置中心能统一改调用参数」
            connect-timeout: 2000
            read-timeout: 4000

logging:
  level:
    com.zjgsu.njb.appointment: info
